caption:
The ways I tricked my subconscious mind to become a self-made millionaire at 30🧠🧠

1. I made a name for myself. Her identity was millionaire Marley, and everything I did, all the actions that I took, all the decisions that I made, were in alignment with what would millionaire Marley do too. I brainwash myself every single morning with affirmations, gratitude journaling, and writing down future self-scripting as if I was already a millionaire. How would I think? How would I wake up? What would my day look like? I literally brainwashed myself into thinking I already was one before I was one, and then I became one🪄🪄

2. I listened to an evening hypnosis every single evening to reprogram and brainwash my mind to think and be a millionaire. I told everyone that I knew and that would listen that I was going to be a millionaire one day and that I actually already was. I really believe that! It took me a lot to get over the fear of saying that, because at first I felt like I was going to puke every time I said millionaire. Once I got over that, for anyone who would listen, I would tell them that I was going to be a millionaire at the age of 30✨✨

3. I made my morning alarm clock: "Good morning, you are a millionaire!" Every single time I turned off my alarm, that was the first thing that I saw when I woke up🔓🔓

If you're interested, I actually put together exactly the tips on how I reprogram my subconscious mind in a training called "Hit Your First 10K". If you comment "EASE", I'll send you the link 🥰🥰💖💖✨
author: Marley Rose Harris | Business, Money & Subconscious Mind
title: 3 Tricks to Reprogram Your Millionaire Mindset
one_liner: Creator shares three subconscious reprogramming habits she used to become a self-made millionaire at 30.
key_points: Adopted a 'millionaire identity' and made all decisions through the lens of that future self
Used daily affirmations, gratitude journaling, and future self-scripting to brainwash herself into a millionaire mindset
Listened to evening hypnosis recordings nightly to reinforce wealth-oriented subconscious beliefs
Set her morning alarm label to 'Good morning, you are a millionaire!' to prime her mindset instantly upon waking
